notes.title: Refreshed UI
notes.content:
Thanks for your awesome support on this game!

I've updated some of the game's interface elements to improve its visual appeal, and now you can zoom out by clicking the right mouse button

Have fun!

notes.title: Fixed Lighting issue
notes.content:
Lighting was a bit messed up, I've fixed it.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Just some UI updates
notes.content:
Hi there, puzzle lovers!

In this version I've just made some UI improvements to give you a smoother game experience

notes.title: Restyling, what a passion! 🎨
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I've been sprucing up the game with a fresh coat of paint – new textures for Boxes and buttons! 
Hope you'll like the updated look and it will make solving puzzles even more fun for you!

notes.title: Fixed the puzzle tiles saving bug
notes.content:
Thanks for your awesome support for Mystery Box! In this update, I've fixed the bug on saving the puzzle tiles you find to discover the inventions.

Have fun!

notes.title: Bug fizes
notes.content:
Just squashed some little bugs here and there. 

Happy New Year to everybody! 🎉

notes.title: Show us your appreciation!
notes.content: Thanks for playing this escape room/puzzle game, if you enjoy it, please consider nominating it above, it's a simple click, but it means the world to me ❤️‍🔥

notes.content:

notes.title: Fixed a small bug on Black Box 8
notes.content:
